submission.natural_language_explanation: At any non-first position, this negative pole fires on trigger words that complete a tight local pairing: the plea verdict 'not' after pleaded/entered, financial 'interest' after raised/pay, past-tense action verbs ('stepped', weakly 'walked'/'runs') after a proper-name, animate, or place subject (Maria/John/dog/river/lake), the copula 'was'/'is' after a proper-name or setting noun (John/Maria/river/house/tree/museum), tally nouns ('points' after scored/counted 13, 'errors' after found 10), 'numpy' after import, 'times' after a numeral, existential 'there', and nouns like report/river/room/house/tree after The/A. The identical word fires weakly or not at all with a different neighbor in the same slot (ordinary negation with was/did before 'not', psychological 'interest' after lost/showed, 'stepped' after inanimate subjects like car/report, 'was' after generic animate subjects like dog/defendant/man, 'numpy' after love/like), and editing words after the peak leaves the peak unchanged.
